sentences.text: Prevotella pectinovora was described from five strictly anaerobic Gram-negative strains isolated from pig fecal samples, which formed a novel and discrete lineage distinct from other known Prevotella species.
The isolates are rod-shaped with rounded ends, non-motile and non-spore-forming.
Their main fermentation products were succinate and acetate, with minor amounts of isovalerate, propionate and isobutyrate, and hydrogen was also produced.
A substantial portion of the genes involved in carbohydrate utilization was reported to be devoted to pectin degradation and utilization.
A comparison of gut microbiome profiles of 76 urban and 81 rural female residents of Vietnam reported Prevotella pectinovora among 17 taxa differing in abundance.
